summarize_constants_module: summarize the fairmotion constants module that defines identity and zero numpy arrays for 3D transformations
use_eye_T: use eye_T to get a copy of the 4x4 identity transformation matrix
use_eye_R: use eye_R to get a copy of the 3x3 identity rotation matrix
use_zero_p: use zero_p to get a copy of the zero 3D position vector
use_zero_R: use zero_R to get a copy of the 3x3 zero rotation matrix
